rejected.label: Mesenteric Ischemia

rejected.label: Adhesional Band Syndrome
rejected.why: While adhesional band syndrome could cause bowel obstruction and similar symptoms, the recent history of Roux-en-Y gastric bypass and the specific CT findings of a cluster of small-bowel loops with a spiral pattern of central mesenteric vessels more strongly suggest internal hernia as the cause of the patient's symptoms.
